title: Yuutousei wa Unmei no Akai Ito Ni Sakaraitai

titleNative: 優等生は運命の赤い糸に逆らいたい
synonyms: The honor student wants to go against the red thread of fate
synopsis: One day, Miyanari, a solid honor student, suddenly saw a red thread of fate connecting him to the delinquent Hashiba in the same class. "There is no way that this guy is the one for me!" But the red thread seemed to cause mischief, as Hashiba helped to treat Miyanari's injury, or when they found themselves trapped together in a room. The more time they spent with each other, the more Miyanari recognized Hashiba's kindness, so different from his delinquent image...? (Source: Pixiv Comic) Note: - The serialization originally ended 2023-02-16. It was then restarted on 2024-12-10. - Chapter count includes 4 extras.

title: Ring ni Kakero
synopsis: Takane Kiku and Takane Ryuji are the children of a legendary world contender boxer. Kiku, the daughter seems to have inherited her father's boxing sense and tries to teach Ryuji to become a world contender. However, Ryuji hates boxing and gets picked on. After Kiku and Ryuji leave their hometown for Tokyo, Ryuji eventually learns to discover a passion for boxing after an encounter with a boxing prodigy, Kenzaki Jun. This will eventually lead him to learn crazy moves and out of this world opponents to become one of Japan's top junior boxers. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Excel Saga
synopsis: Earnest young girls Excel and Hyatt (both codenames) hold down minimum-wage jobs to support their true avocation: trying to conquer the city of Fukuoka for the secret organization ACROSS and its dreamy dictator, Il Palazzo--a man whose dignity is such that he could never acknowledge that ACROSS consists of himself, a leaky basement, two unpaid teenage interns, and a stray dog. But society is all to blame, as creator Rikdo Koshi takes aim at everything from organized religion to public television, in a manga that makes reindeer spit blood and puts puppies on the dinner menu. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

synonyms: The Survival Log of a Butler at the Count's Castle
synopsis: After her treacherous cousin steals her title and fortune, then tries to sell her into marriage, Brienne cuts her hair and disguises herself as a boy to escape. She finds refuge at the Connett Estate—located in a domain that acts as a self-governed city immune to imperial law—working as an assistant butler to the formidable Duke Ulrich Connett. synonyms: A Story Of Taking Home A Lonely Gal From My Class And Turning Her Into An Elegant Beauty
Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.

title: Only Sense Online
titleNative: オンリーセンス・オンライン-
synopsis: Utilizing a system called "Sense," each player aims to create their unique character in the VRMMORPG "Only Sense Online." Joining this realm is Yun, an absolute beginner in the world of gaming, equipped with some of the worst customized "Sense" ever. While his two sisters, both veterans in this world, criticize his choices of equipment, he continues to delve into the skill sets he has acquired. Along his way, he meets the art of "production" and people that have mastered this art. Watch as a total novice creates a revolution in the gaming world and create the "ultimate" support class.
